html:
All-purpose golden lines for the gaokao (China’s college entrance exam) essay, ready to plug in anywhere:

  1. Shouldering the knapsack of youth, I sing of unbridled ideals;
  2. No mountain stands taller than a person, no road runs longer than our feet;
  3. A single drop of water can reflect a sky of boundless love, a single kind feeling can warm a lonely heart
  4. Night tints the waystation of youth, a hidden fragrance lingers in the harbor of the soul
  5. Memory is like water poured into your palm: clench your fist or open your hand, it will slip through your fingers, drop by drop, until it is all gone
